● Why the ocean is warming

blocks.text: Coral skeletons are made of limestone and limestone is dissolved by acid.

blocks.speaker: James Porter
blocks.text: The pH of Coca-Cola is 2.5. Now car battery acid is 1.0, but Coca-cola is 2,5. Pretty acid stuff. Drinking water has a pH of 7. What happens when we pump CO2 into a soft drink, it acidifies the soft drink. So the pH in Coca-Cola of 2.5 is not because of the Coca-Cola's secret formula, it's simply because of CO2. And what's happening is we are turning the oceans into Coca-cola.

blocks.text: some of the low islands in the Pacific, like the Maldives and Karabas.
